submission.design_rationale: Lead with measured feedforward so feedback only trims residual. E4 holds 0.571 at u=0.33, E5 holds 0.527 at u=0.27, E7 holds 0.483 flat at u=0.26, E6 holds 0.466 at u=0.25: linear fit y_ss=0.15+1.32*u gives u*=0.265 for y=0.5, so ff=(target-0.15)/1.32.
